project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with Supabase backend - HR management app for Belgian medical center
test_framework: None configured - validation via npm run build only
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles and pages build correctly
environment_constraints: Internet access available for npm installs. Supabase instance is live at https://jqfaclixnraugzmcrylp.supabase.co with real data (33 employees). No test framework configured.
contribution_requirements: All UI must be in French. Follow existing patterns from the new employee form and detail page.

key_patterns.data_fetching: Client-side with 'use client' directive, useEffect + createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client
key_patterns.form_pattern: useState for form state, handleChange for inputs, handleSubmit with Supabase .insert()/.update(). See src/app/employees/new/page.tsx
key_patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS with custom primary color palette. Cards use 'card' class or bg-white rounded-lg border. Sections use fieldset with sectionClass.
key_patterns.routing: App Router with [id] dynamic segments. Layouts in each route dir with Sidebar + Header.
key_patterns.supabase_client: createBrowserClient from @supabase/ssr, env vars NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

directory_structure: src/app/ contains route directories (employees/, absences/, dashboard/, remuneration/, schedules/, governance/, reports/, settings/, assets/). src/components/layout/ has Sidebar.tsx and Header.tsx. src/lib/supabase/ has client.ts and server.ts. supabase/ has schema.sql and seed-data.sql.
